name: Educated
penalty: Each failed test with an untagged skill gives the GM 1 AP.

name: Fast Shot
benefit: A second major action used for a ranged attack costs only 1 AP.
penalty: The Aim minor action gives you no benefit.

name: Gifted
benefit: +1 to two different S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes of your choice.
penalty: Your maximum Luck points are one below your Luck.

name: Heavy Handed
benefit: +1 CD to your melee damage bonus.
penalty: Melee and unarmed attacks complicate on 19 and 20.

name: Small Frame
benefit: Re-roll 1d20 on AGI tests about balance or contortion.
penalty: Carry weight uses 5 × STR instead of 10 × STR.

name: Mother Wasteland
benefit: Spend 1 Luck for a cryptic insight, worth three uses of Obtain Information.
penalty: Complications make pre-War artifacts harder for you to understand and use.

name: Nomad
benefit: Re-roll 1d20 on Survival tests for travel, camping and foraging; the first complication there is ignored.
penalty: Barter and Speech with settlers are harder and complicate more easily; Science cannot be a Tag skill.

name: Rite of Passage
benefit: The first Luck point spent in a scene may be refunded on an effect rolled on 1 CD.
penalty: Assisting another player character costs you 1 AP first.

name: Tools of the Old World
benefit: Survival can replace Repair or Science for repairing or using pre-War tech.
penalty: Tests with pre-War technology (other than weapons) complicate 2 points more easily.

name: The Chosen One
benefit: The first bought d20 is free on tests for your tribe's quest, and you may succeed at a cost.
penalty: The GM gains 2 AP whenever your quest comes up.
